description.value: Red Burrito is a beloved local Mexican restaurant that opened on Commercial Drive in January 2006 and has grown to multiple Vancouver locations. The kitchen makes everything fresh daily — handmade tamales wrapped in banana leaf, house-ground salsas, and slow-cooked meats — keeping to a simple, quality-focused menu for nearly two decades. Cyclists heading along Commercial Drive will find a filling, made-from-scratch burrito or taco in a lively neighbourhood setting.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: wall_loops (3 spaces) at 33m; rack at 37m; stands (2 spaces) at 67m; stands (3 spaces) at 67m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides strong evidence for this Commercial Drive location. The locations page confirms the address (1700 Commercial Drive, Vancouver, BC V5N 4A3) and supplies a phone number (604-707-0877) absent from OSM. The menu page explicitly lists Vegetarian and Vegan Meat options, and 'Order now' buttons throughout confirm takeout service. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM had no phone number; 604-707-0877 sourced from website's locations page for the East Van / Commercial Drive location.

Inconsistency between website pages on number of locations: the front page states '4 locations in Vancouver and North Vancouver' while the Locations page lists only 3 (East Van, Cambie, Alberni) and the Our Story page also states '3 locations in Vancouver'. One location may have closed or the front page copy is outdated.

Website footer copyright reads '2020-2022', suggesting the site has not been fully updated recently, though OSM check_date of 2026-02-16 and looks_closed=false indicate the business is still operating.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, long-running local restaurant on a major cycling corridor (Commercial Drive) with vegetarian and vegan options and confirmed takeout — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page lists a dedicated Vegetarian filling (Spanish rice, beans, toppings, fresh guacamole) and a Vegan Meat filling (soy-based protein in Red Burrito spices). No gluten-free option mentioned
